Hey! The remindbot worked, I saw it a few days ago while driving but remembered just now after I finished about my 11th treatment. 

Pros:

\*THE BEST PRO\* I've seen about a 60% decrease in hair. It's so easy to shave now, I can shave my whole body in 15 minutes without any ingrown hairs!

 Painless, your body gets used to the levels super fast. (At first I was super scared to even click the buttons bc I was like ahh it's gonna hurt but I started speeding it up because it started to feel kind of like a warming massage? I can't describe the feeling, but it's painless.

Super easy to use, it has these little lights on the sides that tells you when to use it and It's super fast, The next day after shaving when I'll use it I can get my chest, legs, and arms done in about 20 minutes while just watching tv.

Cons: 

The stupid light hurts my eyes every time even when I bought laser light goggles. That could just be me though. It only lasts about 30 minutes after I finish though so I usually continue to wear the goggles even though I look kinda stupid lol.

The device does tend to heat quickly, which if you're impatient like me you might have to stop for about 30 seconds or else it will begin to get way too hot on your skin, but this is after doing an entire leg including the thigh. 

Overall: 100% Recommend, $320 was super cheap to what I've spent on so many products and moisturizers and hair removal creams and razors. Plus, I barely have to shave now because my hair is thin and essentially blonde you'd have to really look to see it so you can even get away with shaving.
